news.title: Mory Kromah: From one world champion to another
news.title_zh: 莫里·克罗马：从一位世界冠军到另一位世界冠军
news.body_en: GLORY heavyweight champion kickboxer Mory Kromah expressed his faith that the next year will be a great one for him and Chelsea as he enjoyed a tour of Stamford Bridge. The Blues supporter visited west London to take in a stadium tour of the Bridge as the reigning GLORY Heavyweight Champion and the top-ranked heavyweight kickboxer in the world. As someone who knows a thing or two about winning titles, the trophies on display in the Chelsea Museum seemed to be the highlight of the Dutchman’s time at the Bridge. ‘It was a great tour around,’ said Kromah. ‘To see the changing room, the museum, the Club World Cup trophy – it’s big, gold and turning! The pride of London, I felt it today. It is the pride of London. ‘For my Chelsea fans, if you know me you know me. If you don’t know me, I’m Mory ‘the Black Ghost’, the undisputed heavyweight champion. You’ll see me this season next to you all watching Chelsea winning games and winning trophies. ‘We want more! That’s what we need, that kind of energy. From one world champion, that’s what I feel.’ You can watch the full interview with Kromah on his visit to Stamford Bridge in the video above.
news.body_zh: GLORY 重量级拳击冠军莫里·克罗马在斯坦福桥之旅中表示相信明年对他和切尔西来说将是伟大的一年。这位蓝军支持者作为卫冕 GLORY 重量级冠军和世界顶级重量级跆拳道选手访问了伦敦西部，参观了伦​​敦桥的体育场。作为对赢得冠军略知一二的人，切尔西博物馆展出的奖杯似乎是荷兰人在蓝桥时期的亮点。 “这是一次很棒的旅行，”克罗马说。 “看到更衣室、博物馆、世俱杯奖杯——它又大又金，而且转动！伦敦的骄傲，我今天感受到了。这是伦敦的骄傲。 “对于我的切尔西球迷来说，如果你了解我，你就了解我。如果你不认识我，我是“黑幽灵”莫里，无可争议的重量级冠军。这个赛季你们会看到我在你们旁边观看切尔西赢得比赛并赢得奖杯。 ‘我们想要更多！这就是我们需要的，那种能量。来自一位世界冠军，这就是我的感受。”您可以在上面的视频中观看克罗马访问斯坦福桥时的完整采访。

news.title: Training ahead of Fulham 🏠
Morgan Rogers: We’re confident of hitting the ground running
news.title_zh: 摩根·罗杰斯：我们有信心迅速起步
news.body_en: Chelsea have to wait until the very end of gameweek one to kick off our Premier League season. But when we do, Morgan Rogers believes the Blues are well placed to make a strong start. Our short trip to Craven Cottage to play Fulham on Monday evening follows the nine other fixtures on the opening weekend of the campaign and heralds a new dawn at Chelsea. Xabi Alonso is preparing to take charge of his first game as our manager and several new players – including Rogers – are hoping to make their competitive debut for the Blues. He may not have been at the Bridge for long, but Rogers is already acutely aware of the standards he and his team-mates are expected to meet. He wants to set the tone for the season right from the off. ‘There’s a process, and there being a new manager, it takes time to gel and fit perfectly, but we do want to hit the ground running,’ said Rogers. ‘We believe we've got the ability and the quality to. ‘The fans want to see their team perform to the level that they expect, and Chelsea Football Club as a whole expect to compete with every team and be right at the top of the league. That's our aspiration and goal. ‘It's about staying focused, and understanding it's a journey. It might not always go perfect, but with the right mentality, with the right mindset, we'll be where we deserve to be and where we need to be as a club and as a team.’ On a personal level, Rogers has been forming connections with his new colleagues as quickly as possible to ensure no time is wasted in getting up to speed. He has also taken information on board about what Alonso expects of him. What is unknown is how the Premier League will pan out this season. Several clubs, including us, Manchester City and Liverpool, have new head coaches. There is a feeling among pundits that it will be an open division and, as always, anyone can beat anyone on their day. ‘It’s exciting times ahead,’ Rogers enthused. ‘I'm as much of a Premier League fan as everyone else. I know I play in it, but I'm still a fan when I'm not playing. So I want as much excitement as possible. ‘No one knows how each team will set up or how everyone will play, and that’s exciting. That’s why we watch the game and why we love the sport. ‘And hopefully, we're in the exciting element of it at the top of the table where we want to be.’
news.body_zh: 切尔西必须等到第一周比赛结束才能开始我们的英超赛季。但当我们这样做时，摩根·罗杰斯相信蓝军已经做好了良好的开局准备。继本赛季首周末的其他九场比赛之后，我们周一晚上将前往克雷文小屋对阵富勒姆，这预示着切尔西的新黎明。哈维·阿隆索正准备作为我们的主教练负责他的第一场比赛，包括罗杰斯在内的几名新球员都希望为蓝军上演他们的正式比赛首秀。罗杰斯可能在蓝桥待的时间不长，但他已经敏锐地意识到他和他的队友应该达到的标准。他想从一开始就为这个赛季定下基调。罗杰斯说：“这是一个过程，而且有一位新主教练，需要时间来磨合并完美适应，但我们确实希望立即开始行动。” “我们相信我们有能力、有能力做到这一点。 “球迷希望看到他们的球队达到他们期望的水平，切尔西足球俱乐部作为一个整体希望与每支球队竞争并跻身联赛榜首。这是我们的愿望和目标。 ‘这是关于保持专注，并理解这是一个旅程。它可能并不总是完美的，但只要有正确的心态，有了正确的心态，我们就会成为我们应得的位置，以及我们作为俱乐部和团队需要达到的位置。”在个人层面上，罗杰斯一直在尽快与他的新同事建立联系，以确保不浪费时间来加快速度。他还听取了有关阿隆索对他的期望的信息。未知的是本赛季英超联赛将如何发展。包括我们、曼城和利物浦在内的几家具乐部都有了新的主教练。专家们有一种感觉，这将是一个开放的分区，一如既往，任何人都可以在当天击败任何人。 “接下来是激动人心的时刻，”罗杰斯兴奋地说。 “我和其他人一样是英超球迷。我知道我在玩它，但当我不玩的时候我仍然是它的粉丝。所以我想要尽可能多的兴奋。 “没有人知道每支球队将如何安排，或者每个人将如何比赛，这很令人兴奋。这就是我们观看比赛以及热爱这项运动的原因。 “希望我们能在积分榜上名列前茅，这是我们想要的。”

news.title: Xabi Alonso on Levi Colwill's importance and place among world's best centre-backs
news.title_zh: 哈维·阿隆索谈列维·科尔威尔的重要性以及在世界最佳中后卫中的地位
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso believes a fully fit Levi Colwill is 'one of the best centre-backs in the world' and insists our Academy graduate will be a key figure for the Blues during the forthcoming campaign. For much of the 2025/26 campaign, the Blues were deprived of Colwill's qualities due to a knee ligament injury sustained on the opening day of pre-season. Thankfully, the England international made a handful of appearances before our campaign was completed, and he has been working with Alonso’s squad since they reconvened at Cobham in July. Colwill featured during our tour of Australia and Asia and started on Saturday as we overcame Real Sociedad at Stamford Bridge in our final pre-season fixture. With the start of the Premier League campaign almost upon us – we open with a short trip across west London to take on neighbours Fulham on Monday evening – Alonso has discussed Colwill’s return to full fitness and what the 23-year-old adds to the side. ‘I would say that having a proper pre-season has helped him in taking the right steps in the right moment, not trying to rush it too quick because of what he had last year,' said our manager. ‘Even last year, he finished playing in a good way. And now, after pre-season, we are expecting that he feels well and that he's confident and with the fitness to have him at the next level.’ That will be music to the Chelsea supporters’ ears, so impressive have Colwill’s performances been at the heart of the Blues defence before his injury. For Alonso, the defender’s potential importance to the team during the coming campaign is clear, too. ‘If he's feeling okay, he's for me one of the best centre-backs in the world, because of his composure, because of his presence. He’s so complete, so dominant. Levi is going to be a key player for us.’
news.body_zh: 哈比·阿隆索相信完全康复的列维·科尔威尔是“世界上最好的中后卫之一”，并坚称我们的青训毕业生将在即将到来的赛季中成为蓝军的关键人物。在2025/26赛季的大部分时间里，由于季前赛首日膝盖韧带受伤，蓝军失去了科尔威尔的能力。值得庆幸的是，这位英格兰国脚在我们的赛季结束之前就出场了几次，自从阿隆索的球队七月份在科巴姆重新集结以来，他就一直在与他们一起工作。科尔威尔在我们的澳大利亚和亚洲之旅中发挥了重要作用，并于周六我们在斯坦福桥击败皇家社会队的季前赛最后一场比赛中首发。随着英超联赛即将开始——我们将在周一晚上穿越伦敦西部进行一次短途旅行，迎战邻居富勒姆——阿隆索讨论了科尔威尔完全恢复健康的情况以及这位 23 岁的球员为球队带来的帮助。 “我想说，适当的季前备战帮助他在正确的时刻采取了正确的步骤，而不是因为去年的情况而急于求成，”我们的主教练说。 “即使是去年，他也以良好的方式完成了比赛。现在，季前赛结束后，我们期待他感觉良好，他有信心并有能力让他达到更高的水平。”这对切尔西支持者来说将是美妙的音乐，在受伤之前，科尔威尔的表现一直是蓝军防守的核心，令人印象深刻。对于阿隆索来说，这位后卫在即将到来的赛季中对球队的潜在重要性也很明显。 “如果他感觉不错，那么对我来说他就是世界上最好的中后卫之一，因为他的镇静，因为他的存在。他是如此完整，如此具有统治力。列维将成为我们的关键球员。

news.title: FC Shakhtar Donetsk to play home Champions League games at Stamford Bridge for the 26/27 season
news.title_zh: 顿涅茨克矿工队 26/27 赛季主场欧冠联赛将在斯坦福桥举行
news.body_en: Subject to regulatory approvals, FC Shakhtar will play their home matches of the UEFA Champions League league phase at Stamford Bridge for the 2026/27 season. Given Chelsea FC’s disappointing 2025/26 season and failure to qualify for European football, the club is pleased to provide FC Shakhtar with the opportunity to play in London - the United Kingdom's capital - for their Champions League campaign. Shakhtar have played in cities across Europe, including Hamburg in Germany and Warsaw in Poland. This coming season, FC Shakhtar will play in London at Stamford Bridge. Chelsea Football Club at Stamford Bridge said: 'FC Shakhtar have played in countries across Europe and we look forward to welcoming them to London for their Champions League campaign this year. 'We will be working with the Shakhtar team closely over the coming weeks to ensure that matchdays run safely and smoothly for their team and supporters.' FC Shakhtar said: 'Playing our Champions League home matches at Stamford Bridge is a special opportunity for Shakhtar. We are grateful to Chelsea Football Club for the opportunity to host our games at this special venue. Stamford Bridge is one of the most famous stadiums in world football, with an incredible history and atmosphere. We are convinced that Shakhtar’s matches in London will provide unforgettable emotions for Ukrainian and English fans.'
news.body_zh: 待监管部门批准后，矿工队将在 2026/27 赛季在斯坦福桥进行欧洲冠军联赛阶段的主场比赛。鉴于切尔西足球俱乐部 2025/26 赛季令人失望且未能获得欧洲足球资格，该俱乐部很高兴为矿工队提供在英国首都伦敦参加欧洲冠军联赛的机会。矿工队曾在欧洲各地的城市踢球，包括德国汉堡和波兰华沙。新赛季，矿工队将在伦敦斯坦福桥球场进行比赛。斯坦福桥切尔西足球俱乐部表示：“矿工队已经在欧洲各国踢球，我们期待着欢迎他们今年来到伦敦参加欧冠联赛。 “我们将在未来几周内与矿工队密切合作，确保他们的球队和支持者安全、顺利地进行比赛。”矿工队表示：“在斯坦福桥进行欧冠主场比赛对矿工队来说是一个特殊的机会。我们感谢切尔西足球俱乐部给我们机会在这个特殊的场地举办我们的比赛。斯坦福桥是世界足球界最著名的体育场之一，拥有令人难以置信的历史和氛围。我们相信矿工队在伦敦的比赛将为乌克兰和英国球迷带来难忘的情感。”

news.title: Five blues named in England's U-20 Women's World Cup squad
news.title_zh: 五名蓝军入选英格兰 U-20 女子世界杯阵容
news.body_en: Lola Brown, Katie Cox, Eva Hendle, Vera Jones and Chloe Sarwie have been named in England's squad for the FIFA U-20 Women's World Cup. The five Chelsea players will represent the Young Lionesses at the tournament in Poland, which takes place from 5 to 27 September and features 24 nations from around the world. The Young Lionesses secured their place at the competition through the UEFA Women's Under-19 Championship pathway and will be aiming to progress through challenging group in Poland. England have been drawn in Group B and will begin their campaign against Canada on Saturday 5 September, with kick-off at 5pm BST. The Young Lionesses then face Tanzania on Tuesday 8 September, also at 5pm BST, before concluding the group stage against Brazil on Friday 11 September at 2pm BST. All three matches will be played in Bielsko-Biała. Everyone at Chelsea would like to congratulate Lola, Katie, Eva, Vera and Chloe on their selections and wish them the very best of luck at the Under-20 Women's World Cup.
news.body_zh: 洛拉·布朗、凯蒂·考克斯、伊娃·亨德尔、维拉·琼斯和克洛伊·萨尔维已入选英格兰队参加 FIFA U-20 女子世界杯的阵容。这五名切尔西球员将代表幼狮队参加 9 月 5 日至 27 日在波兰举行的锦标赛，共有来自世界各地的 24 个国家参加。年轻母狮队通过欧足联 19 岁以下女子锦标赛途径确保了自己的参赛资格，并将目标是在波兰的富有挑战性的小组中晋级。英格兰队被分在 B 组，将于 9 月 5 日星期六下午 5 点（英国夏令时）开始对阵加拿大队的比赛。随后，幼狮队将于 9 月 8 日星期二（英国夏令时）下午 5 点迎战坦桑尼亚，然后于 9 月 11 日星期五下午 2 点（英国夏令时）结束小组赛对阵巴西的比赛。所有三场比赛都将在别尔斯科-比亚瓦举行。切尔西的每个人都祝贺洛拉、凯蒂、伊娃、维拉和克洛伊的入选，并祝愿她们在 20 岁以下女子世界杯上好运。

news.body_en: We are proud to announce that Chelsea FC Museum & Tours has been awarded Tripadvisor's Best of the Best Award 2026, the platform's highest recognition for travel experiences worldwide. This prestigious accolade places us among the top one per cent of attractions globally, based on consistently outstanding reviews and ratings from visitors. With more than eight million listings on Tripadvisor, the award reflects the incredible experiences shared by our guests and the dedication of our team to delivering unforgettable visits to Stamford Bridge. The Best of the Best Award sits above Tripadvisor's Travellers' Choice Awards, which recognise the top 10 per cent of listings, making this achievement an exceptional milestone for our Museum & Tours. Adding to the celebration, we are currently ranked #8 in Tripadvisor's Best of the Best list of Things to Do in London, placing us alongside some of the capital's most highly rated attractions. Whether you are a lifelong Chelsea supporter, a football enthusiast, or simply looking for a unique day out in London, there has never been a better time to experience the stories, history and behind-the-scenes access that make the Chelsea FC Museum & Tour so special. We would like to thank all of our visitors who have taken the time to share their experiences and reviews. Your support has helped us achieve this remarkable recognition, and we look forward to welcoming many more guests in 2026 and beyond. - Click for more information on our Stadium Tours offerings and to book your place on one

news.title: Inside the life of Lucy Bronze
news.title_zh: 露西·青铜的生活内部
news.body_en: With the kick-off to Chelsea Women’s 2026/27 season fast approaching, we caught up with Blues and England defender Lucy Bronze, who extended her contract earlier this summer, to find out a bit more about her life off the pitch... Where did you grow up, and what was it like there? In the North-East of England, in Northumberland. I'd say it was very peaceful and quiet. It didn't feel like it, but it was very far away from anything, really. But it was the best; I played outside every day. Every sport, climbing trees, going to the beach. I had a very peaceful childhood and was very active. At what age did you first start playing football? Pretty much as soon as I could walk. At the age of five or six, my brother was always kicking a football around. I was two years younger –  three or four probably – and was playing, but I probably fell in love with it the most around the age of five or six. What was the name of your first grassroots team? How old were you when you first joined an academy? Who would you say has been the biggest influence on your football career to date? Probably my mum. From being in a village where there wasn't any access to girls' football, she and my dad took me everywhere, but my mum's the one who looked up everything. She didn't even really like football at the time, but she just wanted me to succeed in whatever it was I loved. What's your biggest career highlight to date? I think winning the Euros in England. Who are your best friends in football? My whole life, from the age of 12, I played with Lucy Staniforth. She has just retired this summer, but I think it would have to be her. Can you name your top three favourite players of all time? Marta, Mia Hamm, Rachel Yankey. What do you like to do most away from football? I’m either with my dog or just trying new food. Are you watching any TV series at the moment? I just started rewatching some of the Marvel series because, obviously, Spider-Man has been out, so I'm going back to watch some of the old Marvel movies. If we looked at your Spotify playlist, who would be dominating your most-played artists? At this moment, it's probably Bad Bunny. What are your top three holiday destinations, either that you've been to already or you would like to go to? I'd like to go to Brazil. Of the nice places I've been, Sardinia and Formentera. If you had guests over for dinner, what would you cook for them? I was in Mexico this summer, so I learned how to make proper homemade tacos. Can you tell the fans something that they might not know about you? When I visit new places on holiday, I like to do cooking lessons. What's the best piece of advice you've ever received? What does football mean to you? Football means everything to me. It's how I've made friends and in the whole of my life because of football. So, I'd say close to everything, but not quite.
news.body_zh: 随着切尔西女足 2026/27 赛季开赛的临近，我们采访了蓝军和英格兰后卫露西·布朗兹（她在今年夏天早些时候延长了合同），以更多地了解她的场外生活……您在哪里长大，那里是什么样子？在英格兰东北部的诺森伯兰郡。我想说这是非常平静和安静的。感觉不太像，但确实离任何东西都很远。但这是最好的；我每天都在外面玩。每一项运动，爬树，去海滩。我有一个非常平静的童年并且非常活跃。您几岁开始踢足球？差不多是我刚会走路的时候。五六岁的时候，我哥哥总是踢足球。我比我小两岁——可能三四岁——并且正在玩，但我可能在五六岁左右最爱上它。你的第一个草根团队叫什么名字？您第一次加入学院时几岁？您认为迄今为止谁对您的足球生涯影响最大？可能是我妈妈。在一个无法参加女子足球的村庄里，她和我爸爸带我去任何地方，但我妈妈是那个查阅一切的人。她当时甚至并不真正喜欢足球，但她只是希望我在我喜欢的事情上取得成功。迄今为止，您最大的职业亮点是什么？我认为在英格兰赢得欧洲杯。谁是你足球界最好的朋友？从 12 岁开始，我的一生都是和露西·斯坦尼福斯一起打球。她今年夏天刚刚退休，但我认为必须是她。你能说出你最喜欢的三名球员吗？玛塔、米娅·哈姆、雷切尔·扬基。足球之外你最喜欢做什么？我要么和我的狗在一起，要么只是尝试新食物。你现在在看什么电视剧吗？我刚刚开始重看一些漫威系列，因为显然蜘蛛侠已经上映了，所以我要回去看一些老漫威电影。如果我们查看您的 Spotify 播放列表，谁会主宰您播放次数最多的艺术家？此时此刻，很可能是坏兔子。您已经去过或想去的三大度假胜地是什么？我想去巴西。在我去过的好地方中，撒丁岛和福门特拉岛。如果你有客人来吃饭，你会为他们做什么菜？今年夏天我在墨西哥，所以我学会了如何制作合适的自制玉米饼。你能告诉粉丝一些他们可能不知道的关于你的事情吗？当我假期去新地方时，我喜欢上烹饪课。您收到过的最好的建议是什么？足球对你来说意味着什么？足球对我来说意味着一切。这就是我结交朋友的方式，也是我一生中因为足球而结交朋友的方式。所以，我想说接近一切，但不完全是。

news.title: FPL 2026/27: Chelsea Gameweek one
news.title_zh: FPL 2026/27：切尔西第一周比赛
news.body_en: Chelsea have teamed up with Fantasy Football Scout to help bring you hints, tips and advice during the 2026/27 Fantasy Premier League (FPL) season. Scout will be using their expertise to provide advice and gameweek tips which should prove useful in ensuring you win your mini-leagues. Here, we look at which of the Blues' players are must-haves, who the best value-for-money picks are, and why Joao Pedro(£7.5) is Chelsea’s most popular player. Chelsea’s headline attacking addition, Morgan Rogers (£7.5m) has seen his ownership steadily increase above 25 per cent since starting and scoring against Real Sociedad last weekend. The Englishman has surpassed 160 points in each of the last two seasons, missing just two matches in that time and registering 37 attacking returns. Expected to play a key role on the left-side of the Blues’ attack and could form part of an attacking double-up. At the other end of the pitch Maxence Lacroix (£6.0m) looks set for a strong season at the heart of Chelsea’s backline. The Frenchman has risen in price after notching 154 points in 35 starts for Crystal Palace in 25/26, putting him eighth among defenders. Encouragingly, he returned DefCon points in over half of his appearances. Lacroix also provides attacking threat, racking up 23 shots from set-plays last season, the same amount as Arsenal’s Gabriel. Just like last season,Joao Pedro (£7.5m) is the highest-owned Chelsea player in FPL. The Brazilian currently sits in 62 per cent of teams, second among all players. Pedro’s pre-season form has caught the eye, scoring seven goals in five matches including a hat-trick against Western Sydney Wanderers and a brace at Stamford Bridge at Real Sociedad. Encouragingly for GW1, Chelsea’s new number nine has form against Fulham. In Gameweek 3 last season, Pedro scored the only goal of the game and notched maximum bonus points. Last season, the Brazilian returned 177 Fantasy points thanks to 15 goals and nine assists, his best-ever season across all three metrics. The under-lying data for Joao Pedro in 2025/26 was equally impressive. No Chelsea player managed more shots (73), big chances (26) or Expected Goals (14.96). Levi Colwill (£5.0m) returned to full fitness at the end of season and started in the Blues’ final friendly on the left of the back-three. In his limited Premier League game time in May, the Englishman averaged an impressive 10 DefCon p/90, hinting at potential for plenty of additional points. Only one of Chelsea’s first eight matches rank higher than three on the Fixture Difficulty Rating (FDR), increasing the potential for clean sheets. Likewise, in goal, Robert Sanchez (£5.0m) could provide value between the sticks this season. The Spaniard is owned by just 2 per cent of managers and has surpassed 100 points in each of the last two seasons. Erling Haaland(£15.5m) is likely to be the most captained player this weekend for Manchester City’s home match against Bournemouth. Last season’s Golden Boot winner racked up 239 points in 25/26 thanks to 27 goals, eight assists and 43 bonus points. The Norwegian has scored on the opening day of the season in each of his four seasons in the Premier League with three double-digit hauls in that time. Elsewhere, Bruno Fernandes (£12.0m) could prove a shrewd choice for FPL managers. The Portugal international ended last season just four points behind Haaland following a stunning run of form under Michael Carrick. In the second half of the season, no player delivered more double-digit hauls. This stat showcases Fernandes’ explosive potential. With penalties and other set-pieces in his locker, an away match against newly-promoted Hull City should prove fruitful.
news.body_zh: 切尔西已与 Fantasy Football Scout 合作，帮助您在 2026/27 Fantasy Premier League (FPL) 赛季期间为您提供提示、技巧和建议。球探将利用他们的专业知识提供建议和比赛周技巧，这对确保您赢得迷你联赛很有用。在这里，我们来看看哪些蓝军球员是必备球员，谁是最具性价比的球员，以及为什么若奥·佩德罗（7.5英镑）是切尔西最受欢迎的球员。切尔西的头号进攻新援摩根·罗杰斯（750 万英镑）自从上周末对阵皇家社会的比赛中首发并进球以来，他的所有权稳步增加到 25% 以上。这位英国人在过去两个赛季的得分都超过了 160 分，期间只缺席了两场比赛，并取得了 37 次进攻回报。预计将在蓝军进攻的左侧发挥关键作用，并可能成为进攻包夹的一部分。在球场的另一端，马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦（Maxence Lacroix，600万英镑）看起来将在切尔西后防线的核心位置上度过一个强劲的赛季。这位法国人在25/26赛季为水晶宫首发的35场比赛中拿下154分，在后卫中排名第八，身价也有所上涨。令人鼓舞的是，他在超过一半的出场次数中都获得了 DefCon 积分。拉克鲁瓦还提供进攻威胁，上赛季在定位球中射门23次，与阿森纳的加布里埃尔相同。和上赛季一样，若昂·佩德罗（750 万英镑）是 FPL 中身价最高的切尔西球员。巴西人目前在球队中的出场率高达 62%，在所有球员中排名第二。佩德罗的季前赛表现引人注目，他在五场比赛中攻入七球，其中包括对阵西悉尼流浪者队的帽子戏法以及在斯坦福桥对阵皇家社会队的比赛中梅开二度。令人鼓舞的是，切尔西的新九号在对阵富勒姆的比赛中表现出色，这对GW1来说是令人鼓舞的。上赛季第三场比赛，佩德罗攻入全场唯一进球，获得最高积分。上赛季，这位巴西人凭借 15 个进球和 9 次助攻，获得 177 分幻想积分，这是他在所有三项指标上表现最好的一个赛季。若昂·佩德罗在 2025/26 赛季的基本数据同样令人印象深刻。没有任何切尔西球员的射门次数（73）、绝佳机会（26）或预期进球（14.96）更多。列维·科尔威尔（500万英镑）在赛季结束时完全恢复健康，并在蓝军最后一场友谊赛中首发出场，担任三后卫的左侧。在五月份有限的英超比赛时间里，这位英国人在 DefCon 场均取得了令人印象深刻的 10 分/90 分，暗示着获得大量额外积分的潜力。切尔西的前八场比赛中只有一场在赛程难度等级（FDR）上排名高于三场，增加了不失球的可能性。同样，在门将方面，罗伯特·桑切斯（500万英镑）本赛季可以在门柱之间提供价值。这位西班牙人只拥有 2% 的主教练，但在过去两个赛季中，他的得分都超过了 100 分。埃尔林·哈兰德（1550万英镑）很可能成为本周末曼城主场对阵伯恩茅斯的比赛中担任队长次数最多的球员。这位上赛季的金靴奖得主在 25/26 的比赛中凭借 27 粒进球、8 次助攻和 43 分奖励积分获得 239 分。挪威人在英超联赛的四个赛季中，每个赛季都在赛季开幕日进球，其中三个进球数达到两位数。在其他地方，布鲁诺·费尔南德斯（Bruno Fernandes）（1200万英镑）可能被证明是FPL经理人的精明选择。这位葡萄牙国脚上赛季在迈克尔·卡里克的带领下表现出色，仅落后哈兰德四分。在赛季后半段，没有任何球员能取得更多两位数的成绩。这一数据展示了费尔南德斯的爆炸性潜力。有了点球和其他定位球，客场对阵升班马赫尔城的比赛应该会取得成果。

news.title: Alonso: 'James makes the team better wherever he plays'
news.title_zh: 阿隆索：“詹姆斯无论在哪里打球都能让球队变得更好”
news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has reiterated that Chelsea captain Reece James makes the Blues a better team no matter where he is deployed on the pitch. Having represented England at this summer's World Cup, James returned to Cobham at the start of last week to begin working with Alonso as our preparations for the forthcoming campaign continued. The 26-year-old featured in midfield during our final pre-season friendly of the summer – a 3-1 win over Real Sociedad at Stamford Bridge – and will be in contention to play in our Premier League opener at Fulham on Monday evening. The Blues manager has the option to use James centrally in a back three, as well as at full-back, wing-back, or in central midfield. Yet whichever role the England international is handed in the weeks and months ahead, the quality of our skipper is undiminished. ‘He's flexible in his game, but he needs to feel important,’ said Alonso. ‘I think that's the main thing. Not just because of the role he has as a captain, but also because of the quality he gives to the rest of the team. ‘Wherever he plays, as a right-back or as a midfielder, normally he makes the team better because of his quality, because of his game intelligence, his experience, his composure with the ball. ‘So it's good that we have players that can play in different positions, not just him, other players as well. ‘I see him in a good mood, in a good mindset. For sure, the club means so much to him, and we want to have a good start, a fresh start with good momentum, and that's why the start is so important on Monday.’
news.body_zh: 哈比·阿隆索重申，切尔西队长里斯·詹姆斯无论他被部署在球场上的哪个位置，都会让蓝军成为一支更好的球队。在代表英格兰队参加今年夏天的世界杯后，詹姆斯于上周初返回科巴姆，开始与阿隆索一起工作，同时我们仍在为即将到来的比赛做准备。这位 26 岁的球员在我们今年夏天的最后一场季前友谊赛中担任中场——在斯坦福桥 3-1 战胜皇家社会——并将有望参加周一晚上对阵富勒姆的英超揭幕战。蓝军主帅可以选择在三后卫中集中使用詹姆斯，也可以在边后卫、边后卫或中场中路使用。然而，无论这位英格兰国脚在未来几周和几个月内担任哪个角色，我们队长的能力都不会下降。 “他在比赛中很灵活，但他需要感到自己很重要，”阿隆索说。 “我认为这是最重要的。不仅因为他作为队长的角色，还因为他为球队其他成员带来的品质。 “无论他在哪里踢球，无论是作为右后卫还是中场球员，通常他都能让球队变得更好，因为他的能力、他的比赛智慧、他的经验、他对球的镇定。 “因此，我们拥有能够踢不同位置的球员，这很好，不仅仅是他，还有其他球员。 “我看到他心情很好，心态也很好。当然，俱乐部对他来说意义重大，我们希望有一个良好的开始，一个充满良好势头的新开始，这就是为什么周一的开始如此重要。

news.title: Pre-Season Briefing 2026/27 part five: The anniversaries ahead
news.title_zh: 2026/27 季前简报第五部分：未来的周年纪念日
news.body_en: In the fifth and final part of our series building up to the new season, club historian Rick Glanvill picks out some Chelsea anniversaries we will be celebrating over the next nine months... • One-hundred-and-twenty years since Chelsea’s biggest ever league victory – 9-2 at home to Glossop in Division Two, with debutant ‘Gatling Gun’ George Hilsdon netting five. • Sixty years since a letter from supporter Clifford Webb published in the matchday programme on 7 September 1966 helped popularise a new name for the Fulham Road End at Stamford Bridge – ‘The Shed’. • Fifty-five years since Chelsea thrashed Luxembourg part-timers Jeunesse Hautcharage 13-0 in the Cup Winners’ Cup at Stamford Bridge on 29 September 1971 – completing a UEFA record 21-0 aggregate victory. • Ten years since Chelsea’s 5-0 Bonfire Night flaming of Everton at Stamford Bridge on 5 November 2016 was proclaimed the ‘best performance ever seen in the history of the Premier League’ by veteran commentator John Motson. • Five years since goals from Romelu Lukaku and Kai Havertz beat Palmeiras to earn Chelsea’s first Club World Cup crown on 12 February 2022. • Fifty-five years since the evergreen Chelsea anthem ‘Blue Is The Colour’ was released on Penny Farthing Records on 18 February 1972, reaching no.5 in the charts – unprecedented for a club song. • Twenty years since Didier Drogba’s brace against Arsenal on 25 February 2007 at the Millennium Stadium secured the fourth League Cup final victory in Chelsea’s history. • Seventy years since the first senior men’s match under floodlights at Stamford Bridge – a friendly against Sparta Prague on 19 March 1957. • One-hundred-and-twenty years since temporary manager William Lewis steered Chelsea to the club’s first-ever promotion to Division One with a 4-0 victory over Wolverhampton on 13 April 1907. • One hundred and fifty years since the opening of Stamford Bridge as an athletics venue on 28 April 1877, attended by a crowd of 6,000. • Fifteen years since Roberto Di Matteo’s team beat Liverpool 2-1 in the FA Cup final on 5 May 2012 with goals from Ramires and Didier Drogba. • Fifty years since the young and much-loved Chelsea team managed by Eddie McCreadie and led by Ray Wilkins clinched promotion back to Division One with a 1-1 draw at Wolves on 7 May 1977. • Ten years since Antonio Conte’s barnstorming first season in charge ends with Chelsea, powered by Eden Hazard, Diego Costa and Cesc ‘Magic hat’ Fabregas, winning the league for the sixth time at West Brom on 12 May 2017. • Thirty years since the dawn of a thrilling new era with superstar Ballon d’Or winner Ruud Gullit as coach began with Chelsea winning the FA Cup final against Middlesbrough on 17 May 1997 – our first major silverware for 26 years. • Fifteen years since the Blues’ Champions League triumph on 19 May 2012 at the home of Bayern Munich, who had unfurled pre-match banners proclaiming ‘Our city, our stadium, our trophy.’ We remain London’s first and only winners of the trophy. • Twenty years since Didier Drogba scored the winner against Man United on 19 May 2007 (pictured top) to complete Chelsea’s only FA Cup and League Cup double – we were the third club to complete the feat and the first to claim the FA Cup at the new Wembley (having been the last club to do so at the old stadium in 2000). • Sixty years since Tommy Docherty’s ‘Diamonds’ played the first ever ‘cockney FA Cup final’ at Wembley on 20 May 1967, losing 2-1. • Ten years since John Terry, Chelsea’s most successful youth product and captain, made his final appearance for the club at home to Sunderland on 21 May 2017.
news.body_zh: 在我们为新赛季做准备的系列文章的第五部分，也是最后一部分中，俱乐部历史学家里克·格兰维尔挑选了一些我们将在接下来的九个月里庆祝的切尔西周年纪念日...... • 距离切尔西有史以来最大的联赛胜利一百二十年——在二级联赛中主场 9-2 战胜格洛索普，首次亮相的“加特林枪”乔治·希尔斯顿攻入五球。 • 1966 年 9 月 7 日，球迷克利福德·韦伯 (Clifford Webb) 在比赛日节目中发表的一封信帮助斯坦福桥富勒姆路终点的新名称“The Shed”广为人知，六十年后的今天。 • 55 年前，切尔西于 1971 年 9 月 29 日在斯坦福桥举行的优胜者杯比赛中以 13-0 击败了卢森堡兼职球队 Jeunesse Hautcharage，并以总比分 21-0 创造了欧足联创纪录的胜利。 • 2016 年 11 月 5 日，切尔西在斯坦福桥篝火之夜 5-0 战胜埃弗顿，十年后被资深评论员约翰·莫特森 (John Motson) 称为“英超历史上的最佳表现”。 • 2022 年 2 月 12 日，罗梅卢·卢卡库和凯·哈弗茨的进球击败帕尔梅拉斯，为切尔西赢得首个世俱杯冠军，五年前。 • 1972 年 2 月 18 日，Penny Farthing 唱片公司发行切尔西常青歌曲《Blue Is The Colour》，在排行榜上排名第五，这对俱乐部歌曲来说是史无前例的，五五年前。 • 2007 年 2 月 25 日，迪迪埃·德罗巴在千禧体育场对阵阿森纳的比赛中梅开二度，帮助切尔西队取得了历史上第四次联赛杯决赛胜利，二十年后。 • 自 1957 年 3 月 19 日斯坦福桥在泛光灯下举行的第一场成年男子比赛——1957 年 3 月 19 日对阵布拉格斯巴达的友谊赛以来，已经过去了 70 年。 • 1907 年 4 月 13 日，临时主教练威廉·刘易斯 (William Lewis) 带领切尔西以 4-0 战胜狼队，首次晋升到一级联赛以来，已经过去了 120 年。 • 自斯坦福桥作为田径场启用以来，已经过去了 150 年。 1877 年 4 月 28 日，有 6,000 人参加。 • 2012 年 5 月 5 日，凭借拉米雷斯和迪迪埃·德罗巴的进球，罗伯托·迪马特奥的球队在足总杯决赛中以 2-1 击败利物浦，已经过去十五年了。 • 1977 年 5 月 7 日，埃迪·麦克雷迪执教、雷·威尔金斯带领的年轻而深受喜爱的切尔西队以 1-1 战平狼队，重返甲级联赛已经过去了 50 年。 • 安东尼奥·孔蒂执教的第一个赛季结束后，切尔西队在埃登·阿扎尔、迭戈·科斯塔和“魔帽”法布雷加斯的带领下，于 5 月 12 日在西布朗队第六次赢得联赛冠军，距此已经过去了 50 年。 2017年。 • 在超级巨星金球奖得主路德·古力特担任教练的激动人心的新时代开启三十年后，切尔西于1997年5月17日战胜米德尔斯堡赢得了足总杯决赛——这是我们26年来的第一个重要奖杯。 • 2012 年 5 月 19 日，蓝军在拜仁慕尼黑主场夺得冠军联赛冠军已有十五年了，当时拜仁慕尼黑展开了赛前横幅，上面写着“我们的城市、我们的体育场、我们的奖杯”。我们仍然是伦敦第一个也是唯一一个获得奖杯的球队。 • 2007 年 5 月 19 日迪迪埃·德罗巴 (Didier Drogba) 对阵曼联 (上图) 攻入制胜球，完成切尔西唯一的足总杯和联赛杯双冠王以来的二十年里，我们是第三支完成这一壮举的俱乐部，也是第一支在新温布利夺得足总杯冠军的俱乐部 (2000 年是最后一支在老球场夺冠的俱乐部)。 • 1967 年 5 月 20 日，汤米·多彻蒂 (Tommy Docherty) 的“钻石队”(Diamonds) 在温布利 (Wembley) 举行了首届“伦敦足总杯决赛”，但以 2-1 失利，距此已经过去了 60 年。 • 2017 年 5 月 21 日，切尔西最成功的青年球员兼队长约翰·特里 (John Terry) 在主场对阵桑德兰 (Sunderland) 的比赛中代表俱乐部最后一次出场，距此已经过去了 10 年。

news.body_en: Xabi Alonso has delivered the latest Chelsea team news ahead of our opening Premier League game of the season, with our manager stating he has no fresh injury concerns to contend with. The Blues kick-off the new season with a short trip along the Thames to take on London neighbours Fulham at Craven Cottage on Monday evening. That game starts at 8pm and will be shown live on Sky Sports. Alonso sat down with the media on Thursday at Cobham, where he explained that Danny Welbeck should be fit to feature while the players who returned to pre-season late due to the World Cup are all available. ‘Danny can be involved, he just needed a couple of days not training that much because of a little thing,’ the Spaniard explained at his media briefing. ‘We expect him to be back [training] on Saturday. We need to go day by day, but that is the plan at the moment. ‘With the other players, let’s see. We will check and assess them, but for sure because of the World Cup they came back a little bit later and will need a little more time. ‘But they are all available and can be selected in the line-up against Fulham, for sure.’
news.body_zh: 哈维·阿隆索在本赛季英超首场比赛之前发布了切尔西队的最新消息，我们的主教练表示他没有新的伤病问题需要应对。蓝军将在周一晚上沿着泰晤士河进行短暂的旅程，在克雷文别墅迎战伦敦邻居富勒姆，为新赛季拉开序幕。这场比赛将于晚上 8 点开始，并将由天空体育直播。阿隆索周四在科巴姆接受媒体采访时解释说，丹尼·维尔贝克应该能够参加比赛，而因世界杯而较晚返回季前赛的球员都可以上场。 “丹尼可以参与其中，他只是因为一件小事需要几天没有进行太多训练，”西班牙人在媒体吹风会上解释道。 “我们预计他将于周六回来[训练]。我们需要日复一日地进行，但这就是目前的计划。 “和其他球员一起，让我们看看。我们会检查和评估他们，但可以肯定的是，因为世界杯，他们回来得晚一些，需要更多的时间。 “但他们都可以上场，并且可以在对阵富勒姆的比赛中被选中，这是肯定的。”

news.title: Premier League ticket news: Hull at home
news.title_zh: 英超联赛门票新闻：赫尔城主场
news.body_en: Ticket sales information has been released for our second home Premier League match of the season. The Blues host Hull City at Stamford Bridge on Saturday 12 September with a 3pm kick-off. Supporters intending to travel to or from this game using the London Underground are advised that planned engineering works may affect your journey. There will be no District Line service between Tower Hill and Edgware Road to Wimbledon, Kensington (Olympia), Richmond and Ealing Broadway stations. This means Fulham Broadway Station will be closed all day and there will be no District Line trains running to any nearby stations on that branch of the tube network. There is also no Circle Line from Edgware Road to Aldgate (via Victoria). Home tickets for members for men’s team matches are now allocated through a new application process. For each home match, eligible members have a designated application window during which they can apply for tickets. Applications can be made individually or as a group, provided all members of the group are eligible to apply during that window. Tickets will be allocated one per person with a maximum of four per application. Ticket application window opens – Friday 21 August 12pm Ticket application window closes – Wednesday 26 August 12pm The Ticket application window will be open for True Blue+, True Blue, CFC Blue, and Junior Blue members. As part of the verification process, a pre-authorisation charge £0.01 will be applied to validate your payment card. No money will be taken at this stage, and the hold will be removed by your provider. Tickets for this match are priced at Category B. Please click here for match ticket prices Tickets will appear on the Chelsea Official App prior to the event. Eligible members can submit their application through the ticketing portal at any time during the window, supporters must ensure they are logged in to successfully apply. Applying earlier does not increase the likelihood of success, giving supporters greater flexibility to apply at a time that suits them. As part of the new ticket sales process, members who are eligible for concession-rate tickets are automatically assigned their price class. To ensure you are receiving the correct ticket, please take the time to check the date of birth on your account is accurate. You will only be allocated tickets in your selected areas unless you choose to be considered for other available options. If you only wish to be entered for tickets in one area of the stadium, please leave the second option blank. Please read the ticket application information carefully before submitting your application. Successful and unsuccessful applications will be notified by email within four working days of the ticket application window closing date. Successful applications will be charged to their payment card approximately at this time. Supporters are not able to use account credit for ticket application window purchases. Tickets are for Chelsea supporters only. All persons under the age of 16 will be required to attend with and sit next to, a person aged 18 years of age or over. Members and season ticket holders can purchase Westview tickets for Premier League home games via the Chelsea FC Official Ticketing Portal. A maximum of four tickets can be bought per person, and only the ticket purchaser is required to be a member or season ticket holder. You are not required to be a member or season ticket holder to purchase non-Westview Club Chelsea packages. Club Chelsea tickets are non-refundable unless the match is cancelled, postponed, or moved more than 48 hours either side of the scheduled fixture date. All Club Chelsea ticket purchases are subject to Club Chelsea terms and conditions. For any further Westview enquiries, please email clubchelsea@chelseafc.com. Loyalty points will now only be awarded for attendance at men’s first-team home matches and no longer accrued for purchasing tickets. Points will be added to eligible accounts following each game, provided the ticket has been scanned at the turnstile. This means that supporters purchasing tickets on the ticket exchange, or receiving tickets via ticket forwarding, will now receive loyalty points for attending matches. Supporters will receive three loyalty points for attending this match. Points will be applied after the fixture has been played. Members can still purchase general admission tickets if available in line with the General Admission Policy. Supporters who require accessible tickets can apply through the accessible ticket application window. Timings are below: Accessible ticket application window opens - Friday 21 August 12pm Accessible ticket application window closes – Wednesday 26 August 12pm Supporters, if they are able to do so, can call our Access Team on 0371 811 2012 or 0044 207 915 1950 (international callers) for any questions or if they need further information. Personal assistant tickets can be submitted during this ticket application window. Supporters can apply for car parking by clicking here from Friday 28 August You are required to display your Blue Badge while parked at Stamford Bridge. In addition to season ticket holders, True Blue+, True Blue and CFC Blue members now have the option to list tickets on the ticket exchange if they are unable to attend a home match. Supporters can access the ticket exchange through the Official Ticketing Portal. The sales information on the Buy Tickets page will be updated once the ticket exchange is open. The ticket exchange will close three hours before kick-off, unless stated otherwise. Those unsuccessful in the ticket application window will have a ticket exchange priority window. Once open, season ticket holders and members can send and receive tickets up until three hours before kick-off. Please note that those who have forwarded their ticket will not be able to list their ticket on the ticket exchange. Click for ticket forwarding FAQs Match and ticket application window dates are subject to change. All ticket sales are subject to availability. Please check the website for the latest information.

news.title: Chelsea FC Women announces partnership with Rimmel London ahead of inaugural season at Stamford Bridge
news.title_zh: 切尔西女足在斯坦福桥开赛前宣布与 Rimmel London 合作
news.body_en: Chelsea FC Women today announces a new partnership with Rimmel London, bringing together a club and a brand united by a shared ambition to promote confidence and self-expression. Rimmel London will become an official partner of CFCW for the 2026/27 season, with the partnership seeing us work together across a range of initiatives designed to celebrate the club’s players, our passionate fanbase and the wider women’s football community. Rimmel London is the generation-defying cosmetic brand known for making beauty accessible and encouraging young people to feel confident. With a bold and youthful identity, Rimmel offers a wide range of products across face, eye, lips and nails while combining everyday affordability with on-trend beauty innovation. To kick off the partnership, Katie McCabe, Lauren James and Lucy Bronze all feature in a campaign to spotlight the Match Perfection foundation, designed to deliver long-lasting wear through every match-ready moment. Throughout the 2026/27 season, fans can look forward to Rimmel London bringing community experiences to CFCW home games, including a pop-up at the season opener against Aston Villa Women on 5 September which will be showcasing and sampling Rimmel London's Match Perfection foundation. Rimmel London will also be visible pitch side on the LED boards at every home game. Giulia Mazzia, commercial director for Chelsea FC Women, said: ‘We are thrilled to welcome Rimmel London to the CFCW family. This partnership is a fantastic opportunity to bring together the worlds of women’s football and beauty, while celebrating confidence, individuality and self-expression – all key values our players embrace. We look forward to working closely with the team at Rimmel London.’ Janine Fernandes, vice president of global marketing for Rimmel London, said: ‘Becoming Chelsea Football Club Women’s official partner for the 2026/27 season is an incredible moment for Rimmel, in our hometown of London. The club’s passion for female empowerment and resilience aligns to our values of self-expression and individuality, making our partnership a perfect match. Both brands have a deep cultural impact and influence with dedicated fan bases. By bringing them together, we have an exciting opportunity to grow and champion confidence, the power of self-expression with beauty and to celebrate the power of women both on and off the pitch.’ Further information on upcoming activities will be shared across CFCW’s channels throughout the season.
news.body_zh: 切尔西女足今天宣布与 Rimmel London 建立新的合作伙伴关系，将俱乐部和品牌结合在一起，共同致力于提升自信和自我表达。 Rimmel London 将成为 CFCW 2026/27 赛季的官方合作伙伴，通过此次合作，我们将共同开展一系列旨在庆祝俱乐部球员、我们热情的球迷群体和更广泛的女足社区的举措。 Rimmel London 是一个挑战一代人的化妆品品牌，以让美丽变得触手可及并鼓励年轻人自信而闻名。芮谜 (Rimmel) 凭借大胆而年轻的形象，提供涵盖面部、眼部、唇部和指甲的广泛产品，同时将日常实惠性与流行美容创新相结合。为了拉开双方合作的序幕，凯蒂·麦凯布 (Katie McCabe)、劳伦·詹姆斯 (Lauren James) 和露西·布朗兹 (Lucy Bronze) 共同参与了一场宣传活动，重点宣传 Match Perfection 粉底液，该粉底液旨在为每一个比赛时刻提供持久的穿着效果。在整个 2026/27 赛季中，球迷们可以期待 Rimmel London 为 CFCW 主场比赛带来社区体验，包括在 9 月 5 日对阵阿斯顿维拉女足的赛季揭幕战中展示和试用 Rimmel London 的 Match Perfection 粉底液。 Rimmel London 也将在每场主场比赛的 LED 显示屏上清晰可见。切尔西女足商业总监朱莉娅·马齐亚 (Giulia Mazzia) 表示：“我们很高兴欢迎 Rimmel London 加入 CFCW 大家庭。此次合作是一个绝佳的机会，将女子足球和美丽的世界结合在一起，同时庆祝自信、个性和自我表达——我们的球员所信奉的所有关键价值观。我们期待与 Rimmel London 团队密切合作。”Rimmel London 全球营销副总裁 Janine Fernandes 表示：“成为切尔西足球俱乐部女足 2026/27 赛季的官方合作伙伴，对于我们家乡伦敦的 Rimmel 来说是一个令人难以置信的时刻。俱乐部对女性赋权和韧性的热情与我们自我表达和个性的价值观相一致，使我们的合作伙伴关系完美匹配。两个品牌都具有深厚的文化冲击力和影响力，拥有忠实的粉丝基础。通过将她们聚集在一起，我们有一个激动人心的机会来成长和捍卫自信，用美丽表达自我的力量，并庆祝女性在球场内外的力量。有关即将开展的活动的更多信息将在整个赛季通过 CFCW 的渠道分享。

news.title: FPL 2026/27: Chelsea's best buy, watch and differential
news.title_zh: FPL 2026/27：切尔西的最佳购买、观看和差异
news.body_en: Chelsea have teamed up with Fantasy Football Scout to help bring you hints, tips and advice during the 2026/27 Fantasy Premier League (FPL) season. Scout will be using their expertise to provide advice and gameweek tips which should prove useful in ensuring you win your mini-leagues. It’s difficult to look beyond Joao Pedro (£7.5m), who currently sits in over 60 per of FPL teams after a stunning pre-season. The Brazilian scored seven goals in five matches, including a brace in the Blues’ most recent victory over Real Sociedad. No Chelsea player registered more Expected Goal Involvement (xGI) than our new number nine, with a tally of 14.91.  Encouragingly for Gameweek 1, Joao Pedro netted against Fulham last season. With Manchester United and Liverpool midfielders proving popular due to favourable early fixtures, Cole Palmer (£9.5m) is very much one to watch in the opening Gameweeks of the season. The Englishman should benefit from a summer break and has racked up plenty of pre-season minutes. With penalties in his locker, Palmer could rocket in ownership with a strong performance on Monday night. With Xabi Alonso setting Chelsea up in a back-three formation for the final three pre-season friendlies, Fantasy managers will naturally be drawn to the attacking defenders. Marco Palestra (£5.5m), signed from Atalanta in the summer, has taken up some very advanced positions in pre-season and can play on either side. The Italian currently sits in just 2.7 per cent of Fantasy teams, making him a huge differential with routes to points at both ends of the pitch.

news.title: Rewarding our Official Supporters Clubs with enhanced benefits
news.title_zh: 为我们的官方支持者俱乐部提供更多福利
news.body_en: Chelsea Football Club has launched a refreshed offering for our Official Supporters Clubs, giving Blues around the world even more ways to feel connected to the club, wherever they are. The updated programme introduces a range of enhanced benefits for all official clubs, alongside the opportunity for all clubs to receive reward packages that recognise and celebrate their ongoing engagement and support. Under the refreshed Official Supporters Club Programme, all clubs, outside of ticketing clubs, will move to a single-tier structure, with access to a consistent package of benefits. Ticketing clubs can also access these rewards and benefits but their tiering remains unchanged. These include an official Chelsea Supporters Club wall flag, new certificate of affiliation and new official logo, as well as recognition on Chelsea’s Official Supporters Club website. Clubs will also have the opportunity to request Chelsea support for events and initiatives, receive exclusive content including a dedicated supporters club newsletter, website features and Official Supporters Club-only competitions, and gain access to global supporter events. Additional benefit packages will also be available to all recognised clubs. Through the refreshed rewards structure, Official Supporters Clubs can earn a range of recognition and experience-based benefits as their engagement grows. Depending on the package unlocked, clubs can receive additional items such as an Official Supporters Club pennant or scarves, Chelsea FC merchandise, signed items, exclusive virtual event access, priority access to global CFC events, CFC+ discounts, a player or legend message and even an exclusive matchday experience. More information on rewards and benefits, including FAQs, is available for all supporters to view The available packages, which are named after elements of the Chelsea FC crest, can be found below. 250 members registered on the official website 500 members registered on the official website 1,000 members registered on the official website 2,000 members registered on the official website 15 CFC members (True Blue+, True Blue, CFC Blue, Junior Blue) 50 CFC members (True Blue+, True Blue, CFC Blue, Junior Blue) 100 CFC members (True Blue+, True Blue, CFC Blue, Junior Blue) 200 CFC members (True Blue+, True Blue, CFC Blue, Junior Blue) 5 photos posted of supporters club activities using #ChelseaFCOSC 10 photos posted of supporters club activities using #ChelseaFCOSC 15 photos posted of supporters club activities using #ChelseaFCOSC 15 photos posted of supporters club activities using #ChelseaFCOSC Official Supporters Club pennant 2 Official Supporters Club scarves Access to one exclusive Chelsea FC virtual event Access to all exclusive Chelsea FC virtual events Priority access to global CFC events Priority access to global CFC events Official signed Chelsea FC item This refreshed offering follows the launch of the new Official Supporters Club website, a dedicated platform created to help Chelsea’s global network of clubs stay connected. The website makes it easier for supporters to find and join their local club, discover club activity and share their passion for the Blues with fans across the world. Today, Chelsea is represented by more than 300 Official Supporters Clubs in over 150 countries, with new groups joining every day. From matchday cheering on the team, to local events that bring fans together, our Official Supporters Clubs play a vital role in representing Chelsea across every corner of the globe. news.body_en: Cobham Next Gen kick off our Premier League 2 campaign this week and CFC+ subscribers can watch the opening game live on the Chelsea Official App and website. news.title: Vera Jones joins Watford on loan
news.title_zh: 维拉·琼斯租借加盟沃特福德
news.body_en: Chelsea midfielder Vera Jones has completed a season-long loan to Women’s Super League 2 side Watford. The midfielder recently signed a new contract at Chelsea, committing her future to the club until at least 2029. Jones will now embark on her second loan spell, having spent last season with Bristol City, for whom she played 22 times. She has also represented England at youth level, most recently featuring for the Under-20s. We wish Vera well at Watford and look forward to monitoring her development.
news.body_zh: 切尔西中场球员维拉·琼斯已完成对女足超级联赛第二支球队沃特福德的为期一个赛季的租借。这位中场球员最近与切尔西签订了一份新合同，将她的未来承诺到俱乐部至少到 2029 年。琼斯现在将开始她的第二次租借期，上赛季她在布里斯托尔城效力，她为该队效力了 22 次。她还代表英格兰青年队参加过比赛，最近一次是代表 20 岁以下青年队参赛。我们祝愿维拉在沃特福德一切顺利，并期待监督她的发展。

news.body_en: Valentin Barco has given his first interview as a Chelsea player and you can watch it for free now! Barco completed a transfer from Strasbourg to Chelsea earlier this month and joined up with his new team-mates at Cobham last week following Argentina’s run to the final of the FIFA World Cup. We caught up with the 22-year-old a few days into life as a Chelsea player to ask him how he’s getting on and why he decided to make the move to Stamford Bridge. ‘I’m very happy to be here and to play for this club,’ says Barco in the interview, which you can watch for free below by simply signing in to your account. ‘Chelsea are one of the best clubs in the world. If they are calling you, you have to say yes. It was a top step to come back to the Premier League. ‘The first week was so good. The quality, the intensity, the training has been top. It’s a dream to play for Chelsea.’ During the interview, Barco discusses his relationship with Xabi Alonso, reveals what he is like off the pitch and offers a message to Chelsea fans. He also lists his best attributes and explains why his move from left-back into central midfield during his season at Strasbourg was such a profound development in his footballing journey. ‘It helped me a lot to play again, to be important in the team, to come back to the national team and go to the World Cup, and now to come back to the Premier League,’ says Barco. ‘I feel comfortable playing as a midfielder. I love it because you touch the ball so much. You have to control the tempo of the game. I learned so much how to play as a midfielder, the timings, the tactics. The time was so important for my career and for my life as well.’

news.body_en: Chelsea Football Club is pleased to announce the signing of Alfie Osborne, with the 18-year-old putting pen to paper on a contract with the Blues until 2030. The teenager joins the club from Scottish side Hearts, where he won their B team’s Player of the Year and Players’ Player of the Year awards for 2025/26. After switching from midfield to centre-back last season, Osborne captained Hearts’ Under-18s side to glory in the Scottish FA Youth Cup final. He also played 28 times for Hearts B in the Lowland Football League, the fifth tier of senior football in Scotland. Osborne has represented Scotland several times at youth level, most recently captaining his country in qualifying for the UEFA European Under-19 Championship.

news.title: FPL 2026/27: Xabi Alonso's impact

news.body_en: Chelsea have teamed up with Fantasy Football Scout to help bring you hints, tips and advice during the 2026/27 Fantasy Premier League (FPL) season. Scout will be using their expertise to provide advice and gameweek tips, which should prove useful in ensuring you win your mini-leagues. One of the most significant takeaways from Chelsea’s pre-season was the three-at-the-back formation that Alonso opted for in each of the Blues’ last three warm-up fixtures. Seeing Chelsea with three at the back, it's hard not to be reminded of Antonio Conte’s 2017 title-winning side and the attacking threat Marcos Alonso and Victor Moses provided from wing-back. New signings Marco Palestra (£5.5m) and Pep Chavarria (£5.0m) are two players to watch in this regard. The Italian in particular has caught the eye in pre-season by getting into some very advanced positions. This formation could also benefit new signing Maxence Lacroix (£6.0m), who thrived in Fantasy last season playing the middle of a back-three at Crystal Palace. This is the position that the Frenchman played against Real Sociedad at Stamford Bridge. If Alonso opts to play 3-4-3 in the majority of fixtures, Lacroix could prove value for money, despite being £1.0m more expensive than Levi Colwill (£5.0m). Only two defenders notched more Defensive Contribution points than Lacroix last season. If the Blues’ most recent friendly is anything to go by, then two players in Alonso’s midfield  pivot will have plenty of routes to Fantasy points this season. Likely starter Moises Caicedo (£5.5m) racked up 10 defensive contributions in the 76 minutes he played. The Ecuador international also demonstrated his attacking threat on the pre-season tour, notching a goal and an assist from a corner. His partner last weekend was Reece James (£5.5m), who impressed in the middle of the park, picking up an assist and making two key passes. One player seemingly loving life under Alonso is Joao Pedro (£7.5m). The Brazilian has bounced back from his World Cup omission with seven goals and two assists in just five pre-season matches. After his hat-trick in our first game in Australia, Alonso spoke about how 'he’s very hungry' and 'determined to have a good season' once again. With Cole Palmer (£9.5m) and Morgan Rogers (£7.5m) potentially lining up behind him in the two number 10 positions, expect the former Brighton man to have plenty of goal scoring opportunities.

news.title: Under-18s report: Chelsea 2-3 Norwich City
news.title_zh: 18岁以下青年队报告：切尔西2-3诺维奇
news.body_en: Chelsea Under-18s began the 2026/27 season with a narrow defeat at Cobham, as Norwich City came from behind in the second half to secure a 3-2 victory in our opening Under-18 Premier League fixture. The young Blues made the breakthrough during the first half through Eden Mahoney-Smith, who capitalised on a mix-up in the Norwich defence to give Chelsea the lead after 19 minutes. We took that advantage into half-time, although Norwich had threatened shortly before the interval when Henry Edwards fired over the crossbar. The visitors responded quickly after the restart, with Kahlil Steele equalising before the Norwich forward took centre stage. He won and converted a penalty to put the Canaries ahead, then completed his hat-trick with an impressive free-kick into the far corner. Chelsea continued to battle and gave ourselves hope late on when Jack Anderson's effort took a deflection on its way into the Norwich net. However, despite pushing for an equaliser in the closing stages, the young Blues were unable to find a third and Norwich held on to take all three points. Chelsea went into our first competitive fixture of the new campaign looking to make a positive start at Cobham, and the opening goal arrived midway through the first period. A long ball forward looked as though it would be dealt with comfortably by the Norwich defence, but a misunderstanding between defender Ollie Oldfield and goalkeeper Lucas Alvarado presented Mahoney-Smith with an unexpected opportunity. With both Norwich players caught out, the Chelsea forward was left completely unchallenged and raced through towards an empty goal. He kept his composure to roll the ball into the net and give us a 1-0 lead after 19 minutes. It was one of the more straightforward finishes Mahoney-Smith is likely to have this season, but his alertness to anticipate the mistake ensured the opportunity did not go to waste. Norwich remained in the contest and began to pose a greater threat as the first half progressed. Their best opportunity to draw level before the break fell to Edwards, who found space in a promising position but sent his effort over the crossbar. That meant Chelsea headed into the interval with our one-goal advantage intact and 45 minutes away from beginning the new league campaign with a victory. The complexion of the game changed quickly following the restart. Four minutes into the second half, Steele found the equaliser for Norwich, bringing the visitors level at 1-1 and giving them renewed momentum. Chelsea almost regained the lead when substitute Isaac Badu rattled the crossbar with a powerful strike. But Steele continued to cause problems as the half wore on and was involved again when the Canaries were awarded a penalty. Steele had won the spot-kick himself and stepped forward to take responsibility from 12 yards, converting to complete the turnaround and put Norwich 2-1 ahead after 71 minutes. Chelsea were now searching for a response, but instead it was the visitors who struck again eight minutes later. Norwich won a free-kick in a dangerous position and Steele completed his hat-trick in impressive fashion, producing a well-taken set-piece which found the far corner and left Chelsea facing a two-goal deficit with a little over 10 minutes remaining. The young Blues refused to give in and quickly set about trying to find a way back into the contest. That persistence was rewarded in the 83rd minute. Anderson took aim towards the Norwich goal and his effort picked up a deflection which sent the ball beyond the goalkeeper and into the net. It reduced Norwich's advantage to 3-2 and gave Chelsea renewed belief heading into the closing stages. With the deficit back to a single goal, we pushed forward in search of an equaliser and attempted to apply pressure to the Norwich defence during the remaining minutes, with Mahoney-Smith shooting just wide in the final minutes. Our Under-18s will be back in action on Saturday when we travel to Birmingham City for a U18 Premier League clash, which will once again be shown live on CFC+. news.body_zh: 切尔西 U-18 队在 2026/27 赛季开始之际，以微弱优势输给科巴姆，诺维奇城在下半场后来居上，在我们的 U-18 英超首场比赛中以 3-2 获胜。年轻的蓝军在上半场通过艾登·马奥尼·史密斯取得突破，他利用诺维奇防守的混乱，在第 19 分钟后帮助切尔西取得领先。尽管诺维奇在中场休息前不久亨利·爱德华兹的射门高出横梁，但我们还是将这一优势带入了半场。比赛重新开始后，客队迅速做出反应，卡里尔·斯蒂尔扳平比分，随后这位诺维奇前锋登上了舞台中央。他赢得了胜利，并罚入点球，帮助加那利队取得领先，然后以一记令人印象深刻的任意球射入远角，完成了帽子戏法。切尔西继续战斗，并在最后时刻杰克·安德森的射门偏转进入诺维奇的球门，这给了我们希望。然而，尽管在最后阶段力争扳平比分，年轻的蓝军却未能取得第三分，诺维奇最终全取三分。切尔西进入了新赛季的第一场比赛，希望在科巴姆取得一个积极的开局，并且在第一节中段就取得了首个进球。一个长传前锋看起来诺维奇的防守可以轻松应对，但后卫奥利·奥德菲尔德和门将卢卡斯·阿尔瓦拉多之间的误解给马奥尼·史密斯带来了一个意想不到的机会。由于两名诺维奇球员都陷入困境，切尔西前锋完全没有受到任何挑战，并冲向空门。 19分钟后，他保持镇静，将球送入球网，帮助我们1-0领先。这是马奥尼·史密斯本赛季可能完成的更直接的比赛之一，但他对错误的预见性确保了机会没有浪费。诺维奇仍然留在比赛中，并随着上半场的进展开始构成更大的威胁。中场休息前扳平比分的最佳机会落在了爱德华兹身上，他在一个有希望的位置找到了空间，但射门却高出了横梁。这意味着切尔西在进入中场休息时保持一球优势，距离新赛季联赛的胜利还有 45 分钟。比赛重新开始后，脸色迅速发生了变化。下半场开场四分钟，斯蒂尔为诺维奇扳平比分，将客队1-1扳平，给他们带来了新的动力。当替补出场的艾萨克·巴杜以一记强力射门击中横梁时，切尔西几乎重新领先。但斯蒂尔在下半场继续制造麻烦，并在金丝雀获得点球时再次参与其中。第71分钟，斯蒂尔亲自赢得点球，并在12码处上前主罚，完成逆转，诺维奇2-1领先。切尔西现在正在寻求回应，但八分钟后客队再次发起进攻。诺维奇在危险的位置赢得了任意球，斯蒂尔以令人印象深刻的方式完成了他的帽子戏法，他漂亮的定位球找到了远角，让切尔西在比赛还剩10多分钟时面临两球落后的局面。年轻的蓝军拒绝屈服，并迅速开始寻找重返比赛的方法。这种坚持在第83分钟得到了回报。安德森瞄准诺维奇的球门，他的射门发生偏转，皮球越过了门将并入网。这将诺维奇的优势缩小到3-2，并让切尔西在进入最后阶段时重新燃起了信心。当比分落后到一球时，我们向前推进，寻找扳平比分的机会，并试图在剩下的时间里向诺维奇的防守施加压力，马奥尼-史密斯在最后几分钟的射门稍稍偏出。我们的 18 岁以下青年队将于周六重返赛场，届时我们将前往伯明翰市参加 U18 英超联赛的比赛，这场比赛将再次在 CFC+ 上直播。单击此处，只需 14.99 英镑即可注册整个赛季。 切尔西：艾萨克·科林森、莱利·埃博（加布里埃尔·桑布 81）、乔什·亨利（尤努斯·林顿 82）、雅各布·霍尔、伊萨戈·席尔瓦、雅各布·达科（杰克·安德森 80）、伊登·马奥尼-史密斯、艾萨克·麦吉尔瓦里（艾萨克·巴杜 58）；安德鲁·彭尼（Kwamina Ampah 75），赫泽·格里姆韦德，特雷·法罗莫-阿德巴约未使用的替补：杰克·穆雷，伊曼纽尔·艾因德得分者：马奥尼·史密斯19，安德森83黄牌：39号大厅诺维奇城：卢卡斯·阿尔瓦拉多，杰克·格洛索普（艾萨克·斯坦森43），奥利·奥德菲尔德，塞缪尔·奥古斯托，杰登Munikwa (Ademidire Akarakiri 69)、Jeremiah Sinclair-Brown、Aaron Goodson (Joseph Kipa 61)、Reece Wilkes、Ollie Roberson (Jack Duffy 61)、Kahlil Steele、Henry Edwards (Hugo Collins 61)未上场替补：William Bullen、Bobby Crane得分手：Steele 49、71（笔）、 79张黄牌：奥古斯托 15、斯蒂尔 67、柯林斯 90+2

news.title: New contract and loan for Katie Cox
news.title_zh: 凯蒂·考克斯的新合同和贷款
news.body_en:
Goalkeeper Katie Cox has committed her future to Chelsea by signing a new three-year contract and will now head out on loan to Nottingham Forest for the 2026/27 season.
 Cox has been with the Blues since the age of eight, impressing while graduating through our Academy system. In 2022 she won the FA Youth Cup and was named Chelsea Women’s Academy Player of the Year two years later. After featuring as an unused substitute for the senior team on several occasions, the 20-year-old spent the 2025/26 season on loan in Scotland with Aberdeen, where she quickly established herself as first choice between the posts, featuring in 23 of their 26 league fixtures. Upon signing her new deal, the goalkeeper said: ‘I’m delighted to be able to continue my future at Chelsea and be offered another contract at my childhood club. It's a great opportunity to continue developing and keep learning from the best players and coaches in the world. ‘I want to keep learning, stay down-to-earth and be humble. I want to give a massive thanks to my parents for supporting me, especially over the last year while I've been so far away from home. ‘I’d also like to thank Phil (Radley) and Sonia (Bompastor) for putting their trust and belief in me and for seeing me as a part of the future at this club.’ Cox has also represented England from Under-16s to Under-23s level, being part of the squad which reached the semi-finals of the UEFA Women’s European Under-19 Championship in 2024. She will be joining a Nottingham Forest side who finished seventh in their first season in WSL 2, having won National League North during the 2024/25 campaign.
news.body_zh:

 考克斯从八岁起就加入了蓝军，从我们的学院系统毕业时给人留下了深刻的印象。 2022年，她赢得了青年足总杯，并在两年后被评为切尔西女子学院年度最佳球员。这位20岁的球员在多次作为成年队的替补出场后，在2025/26赛季被租借到苏格兰阿伯丁队，在那里她很快确立了自己作为首发球员的首选，在他们的26场联赛中出场了23场。在签署新合同后，这位门将表示：“我很高兴能够在切尔西继续我的未来，并在我儿时的俱乐部获得另一份合同。这是一个继续发展并向世界上最好的球员和教练学习的绝佳机会。 “我想继续学习，脚踏实地，保持谦虚。我要非常感谢我的父母对我的支持，特别是在过去的一年里，当我远离家乡时。 “我还要感谢菲尔（拉德利）和索尼娅（邦帕斯托）对我的信任和信念，并将我视为俱乐部未来的一部分。”考克斯还代表英格兰从 16 岁以下到 23 岁以下级别，成为 2024 年欧足联女子欧洲 19 岁以下锦标赛半决赛的一员。她将加盟诺丁汉森林队，该队在 WSL 的第一个赛季获得第七名2、在 2024/25 赛季赢得国家联赛北部冠军。

news.body_en: Chelsea midfielder Reggie Walsh will spend the 2026/27 season on loan at League One side Wigan Athletic. Walsh signed with the Blues as an under-8 and became the third-youngest player to make his senior debut for the club when he featured, aged 16 years and 193 days, in our UEFA Conference League semi-final victory over Djurgarden in 2024/25. The 17-year-old represented the senior side again in last season’s UEFA Champions League win over Ajax, before making two appearances for Xabi Alonso’s team during this summer’s pre-season tour of Asia and Australia. Walsh was an important member of the Chelsea Under-21s team which finished top of the Premier League 2 table last season, and helped our Under-18s defeat Manchester City in the Under-18 Premier League national final at Stamford Bridge. We look forward to supporting and monitoring Reggie's progress during his time in League One.

news.body_en: Ahead of the full launch of EA Sports FC 27 next month, we can reveal the full Chelsea player ratings for this year's edition of the game. The latest entry in the franchise launches globally on 25 September 2026, but manufacturer Electronic Arts (EA) has confirmed the full ratings for the Chelsea players from both our Men's and Women's sides. Discover the ratings from this year's edition below... Enzo Fernandez and Moises Caicedo share the honour of being the highest-rated players from the Men's team. The Argentina international – who struck 15 goals for the Blues last season – has seen his rating increase to 86 in the latest edition of the game, while another dependable campaign from Caicedo has also earned him an 86-rated card. Cole Palmer is our third-highest-rated player in FC 27, with the England international receiving an 85 rating. Hannah Hampton claims the honour as our highest-rated Women's player. The England international has established herself as one of the finest goalkeepers in the women's game and has earned an 87-rated card. Summer recruit Katie McCabe, who joined the Blues from London rivals Arsenal, has been given an 86 rating in this year's game. Seven members of the Chelsea squad have been given 85-rated cards in FC 27: England trio Lucy Bronze, Keira Walsh and Lauren James, defender Ellie Carpenter, Blues legend Erin Cuthbert and attacking duo Sandy Baltimore and Alyssa Thompson.

news.title: Lifting the Lid with Wieke Kaptein
news.title_zh: 与 Wieke Kaptein 一起揭开盖子
news.body_en: Chelsea's Wieke Kaptein answers our quick-fire questions to help discover what the midfielder and her Blues team-mates are really like behind the scenes… Who is the first player out on the pitch for training? Ooh, that's difficult. Maika (Hamano). Maika and I are always early, and Aggie (Beever-Jones) too, to be honest. Who do you usually eat lunch with at Cobham? Just with the team, with everyone. It changes every day.What is the first thing you do when you get home after training to switch off? Who do you sit with when you travel to away games? Who is the biggest joker in the squad? Ooh, another difficult one. We've got a lot of them! I like Kiera (Walsh)'s jokes, sometimes. Who is the loudest member of the squad? Again, it depends. I think everyone a little bit. Ellie (Carpenter) can be loud. Alyssa (Thompson) and Nay (Naomi Girma) when they're together. Me and Aggie also! Which Chelsea player is most active on social media that we should follow? Who do you sit with on match-days? Last season I sat between Sandy (Baltimore) and Jojo (Johanna Rytting Kaneryd). Let's see this season! What is the last thing you do before you walk out of the tunnel for a match? I always click on the home screen on my phone to see a picture of my family. Who is the first person you send a message to after a game? Which outfield player do you think would make the best goalkeeper? Which defender or midfielder would be the best striker? Sio (Sjoeke Nusken). She can play anywhere!
news.body_zh: 切尔西队的 Wieke Kaptein 回答了我们的快速问题，以帮助了解这位中场球员和她的蓝军队友在幕后的真实情况……谁是第一个上场训练的球员？哦，这很难。舞花（滨野）。老实说，麦卡和我总是早到，阿吉（比弗-琼斯饰）也是。你通常在科巴姆和谁一起吃午餐？只是与团队，与每个人。它每天都在变化。训练结束后回到家你做的第一件事是什么？当你前往客场比赛时，你和谁坐在一起？谁是队里最大的小丑？哦哦，又是一个困难的事情。我们有很多！有时我喜欢基拉（沃尔什）的笑话。队伍中声音最大的成员是谁？同样，这取决于情况。我想每个人都有点。艾莉（卡彭特）可能很吵。艾莉莎（汤普森饰）和奈（娜奥米·吉尔玛饰）在一起时。我和阿吉也是！哪位切尔西球员在我们应该关注的社交媒体上最活跃？比赛日你和谁坐在一起？上个赛季我坐在桑迪（巴尔的摩）和乔乔（约翰娜·瑞廷·卡内里德）之间。这一季我们拭目以待吧！走出隧道参加比赛之前你做的最后一件事是什么？我总是点击手机的主屏幕来查看家人的照片。比赛结束后你第一个发信息给谁？您认为哪位外场球员会成为最佳门将？哪位后卫或中场球员会是最好的前锋？西奥（Sjoeke Nusken）。她可以在任何地方玩！

news.title: Pre-Season Briefing 2026/27 part three: New rules and regs
news.title_zh: 2026/27 年季前简报第三部分：新规则和规定
news.body_en: In the next instalment of our preview series looking ahead to the new campaign, club historian Rick Glanvill details which changes to the laws of the game the Premier League have adopted for 2026/27… As already witnessed at the World Cup, players must leave the field for one minute after receiving treatment, up from the previous 30 seconds. No more than five seconds must elapse before the taking of a goal-kick or throw-in, with possession awarded to the other team should this not be adhered to. Substitutes are now permitted just ten seconds to leave the field of play at the nearest point. Failure to do so will result in the replacement player being delayed until the next stoppage after one minute has passed. The VAR system can now review incidents where second yellow cards have led to a red card. The Premier League has decided against allowing VAR staff to overturn incorrectly-awarded corners. In the Carabao Cup, a player moving during the winter transfer window may not play for one club in the first leg of the semi-final and another in the second, but may represent their new club in the final. Loan players no longer need written permission from their parent club in order to play in the competition. - The penultimate part of our Pre-Season Briefing tomorrow will look at Chelsea player stats...

news.title: Morgan Rogers on versatility, playing with Cole Palmer and why ‘pressure brings excitement’
news.title_zh: 摩根·罗杰斯谈多才多艺、与科尔·帕尔默一起打球以及为什么“压力带来兴奋”
news.body_en: Saturday’s game against Real Sociedad at Stamford Bridge gave Chelsea supporters a first glimpse of Morgan Rogers and Cole Palmer playing side by side. It is a thrilling prospect. The attacking duo, great mates of course, lined up in adjacent number ten roles behind Joao Pedro. The positional fluidity Xabi Alonso affords to his team meant Rogers, Palmer and Joao Pedro were regularly popping up all over the park. Indeed, if you look at our opening goal on Saturday, Rogers and Joao Pedro are in central striking positions ready to attack Pedro Neto’s inswinging cross. The Brazilian meets it, with Rogers on hand to gobble up the loose ball and open his Blues account. Rogers was nominally positioned on the left of that trio, but for the goal had manoeuvred himself to the right of Joao Pedro, with Palmer lurking behind them. It was an early example of how Rogers and Palmer work in tandem. They may be ostensibly similar players who play in similar positions, but Rogers knows the key to making the most of his and Palmer’s varied assets. ‘By helping each other,’ he says. ‘We have different qualities, different ways of playing the game and affecting games. Playing off each other and helping each other's strengths and weaknesses can work. ‘We do a lot of things that are different. Ultimately, it's about scoring and creating and linking the game. We do that in our own different ways. ‘And even if it might be more of a game suited for one than the other, we can still have our impact. It's about helping each other with the rest of the team, learning off each other and trying to get the best version of Chelsea as possible.’ That attitude is central to Rogers’ thinking about his own role, too. We have seen him thrive during his time at Aston Villa in different positions: as a number ten, an eight, and on the flanks. Wherever Alonso chooses to deploy him in Chelsea blue, Rogers is solely focused on maximising his output for the greater good. ‘I can play in a number of positions and that's probably a strength of mine,’ says the 24-year-old. ‘I can adapt and give managers a different outlook on different positions. I've always grown up being that way. Understanding the game and learning the game and enjoying it and loving it as much as I do, I never wanted to be bogged down to one position or one attribute. Being versatile helps me. Rogers adds: ‘It's a team game, it's 11 players on the pitch, and whatever role I'm given and whatever the manager and other players want from me, I'm going to do to the best of my ability. I’m not a player that gets bogged down having to be the guy to score or assist. ‘As long as I'm contributing and creating and providing or doing whatever's necessary to score and to win, that's all I care about.’ As one of the most eye-catching transfers of the summer so far, Rogers’ move from the West Midlands to west London inevitably comes with additional expectations, particularly from outside observers. Rogers is calm at that prospect, though, and ready to meet the challenge head-on. ‘Pressure brings excitement,’ he says. ‘I think if you're not playing for anything, that excitement, that buzz, that feeling, isn't there. To play with that pressure and that feeling is only going to help. ‘I'm looking forward to it. I'm excited. I let other people talk about stuff like that off the pitch. 'I'm just going to show what I can do on the pitch and why I'm here and why I should be here, and how I can influence and help the team and impact games. That’s all I'm here to do.’ We don’t have long to wait now until we see Rogers put that perspective into practice.
news.body_zh: 周六在斯坦福桥对阵皇家社会队的比赛让切尔西球迷第一次看到摩根·罗杰斯和科尔·帕尔默并肩作战。这是一个令人兴奋的前景。这对进攻二人组当然是伟大的搭档，在若昂·佩德罗身后排列着相邻的十号位置。哈比·阿隆索为他的球队提供的位置流动性意味着罗杰斯、帕尔默和若昂·佩德罗经常出现在公园各处。事实上，如果你看看我们周六的首个进球，就会发现罗杰斯和若昂·佩德罗处于中锋位置，准备攻击佩德罗·内托的内旋传中。巴西人迎击了对手，罗杰斯在场，吞下掉球并打开了他的蓝军账户。罗杰斯名义上位于三人组的左侧，但为了进球，他将自己移至若昂·佩德罗的右侧，而帕尔默则潜伏在他们身后。这是罗杰斯和帕尔默合作的早期例子。他们表面上可能是相似的球员，踢相似的位置，但罗杰斯知道充分利用他和帕尔默不同资产的关键。 “通过互相帮助，”他说。 “我们有不同的品质、不同的比赛方式以及影响比赛的方式。互相竞争并帮助对方的长处和短处是可行的。 ‘我们做了很多不同的事情。最终，这是关于得分、创建和链接游戏。我们以自己不同的方式做到这一点。 “即使这可能是一款更适合其中一种游戏的游戏，但我们仍然可以发挥我们的影响力。”这是关于与球队其他成员互相帮助，互相学习，并努力让切尔西尽可能成为最好的版本。”这种态度也是罗杰斯思考自己角色的核心。我们看到他在阿斯顿维拉的不同位置上都表现出色：十号位、八号位和边路。无论阿隆索选择将他部署在切尔西蓝色的何处，罗杰斯都会专注于最大化他的输出以实现更大的利益。 “我可以胜任多个位置，这可能是我的强项，”这位 24 岁的球员说道。 “我可以适应并为经理们提供对不同职位不同的看法。我一直都是这样长大的。像我一样理解比赛、学习比赛、享受比赛、热爱比赛，我从来不想陷入一种位置或一种属性。多才多艺对我很有帮助。罗杰斯补充道：“这是一场团队比赛，场上有 11 名球员，无论我被赋予什么角色，无论主教练和其他球员对我有什么要求，我都会尽力而为。”我不是一个陷入必须得分或助攻的球员。 “只要我能贡献、创造、提供或做任何必要的事情来得分和获胜，这就是我所关心的。”作为今年夏天迄今为止最引人注目的转会之一，罗杰斯从西米德兰兹转会到西伦敦不可避免地会带来额外的期望，尤其是来自外部观察家的期望。不过，罗杰斯对这一前景很平静，并准备好迎接挑战。 “压力带来兴奋，”他说。 “我认为如果你不为任何事情而打球，那么那种兴奋、那种嗡嗡声、那种感觉就不存在了。带着这种压力和感觉打球只会有帮助。 ‘我很期待。我很兴奋。我让其他人在场外谈论类似的事情。 “我只是要展示我在球场上能做什么，为什么我在这里，为什么我应该在这里，以及我如何影响和帮助球队并影响比赛。这就是我来这里的全部目的。”我们很快就能看到罗杰斯将这一观点付诸实践。

news.title: Introducing Cobham Next Gen
news.title_zh: 科巴姆下一代简介
news.body_en: From the start of the 2026/27 season, Chelsea's Under-21s and Under-19s squads will be known as Cobham Next Gen (CNG) under head coach Harry Hudson. The new name more accurately reflects the age profile of our leading Academy side and Chelsea's long-standing heritage of developing the next generation of players for the senior game. While the squad competed in Premier League 2 as an Under-21s side, its average age last season was closer to that of an Under-18s group, with several players as young as 16 years old featuring regularly. Cobham Next Gen also better fits the role of the squad within the Academy. It recognises a group of young players with momentum, taking the next step in their development - the final one in the pathway to senior football - competing at a higher level as they continue their journey through Cobham towards the men's team. Chelsea's Academy has a proud history of producing players for the men's team. Club captain Reece James, Levi Colwill and Josh Acheampong are among the Academy graduates in our current senior squad. Many more have gone on to enjoy successful careers throughout English football and across Europe's leading leagues, reflecting the quality of the Chelsea development programme and our commitment to transitioning players made in Cobham into first team football. Providing young players with opportunities to compete above their natural age group remains a key part of the club's approach to player development. That was reflected last season as one of the youngest squads in the Premier League 2 finished at the top of the table. The introduction of Cobham Next Gen also strengthens the Academy's identity. More than an age-group name, it represents the players progressing through Cobham and the opportunities available to them as they continue their development towards the men's game. This new identity reflects the distinction of Chelsea’s Academy as a unique footballing environment with its own history, culture and proven record of developing players for the highest level of the game. You can watch Cobham Next Gen fixtures – and those of our Under-18s – throughout the season on the Official Chelsea App and website via a CFC+ subscription.
